topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: Well, now, that’s as fine as rain in Spring! I reckoned they’d be as relieved as a cow in clover when they heard the news. All that fuss and worry, now swept away like last year’s leaves. I’ll wager they’re thinking of all the time they can spend tending to the hedges or mending the roof, things that needed doing but were pushed aside. And maybe they’ll even go for a stroll down to the stream, enjoy the sunshine whilst it lasts. Ain’t it just the way, the best plans sometimes turn out best when they’re not carried out at all.
